title: Tools, Agents & MCP
summary: Give models hands: carefully: tool calling, agent loops, workflow-vs-agent judgment, MCP, and human approval gates.
outcomes: Implement tool calling: schemas, execution, and result handling
Explain the agent loop and its failure modes
Choose deterministic workflows over agents when paths are known
Bound agents with least privilege, loop budgets, and approval gates; place MCP correctly

lessons.title: The agent loop, and how it fails
